## Modules

- [Mailglass.Clock](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Clock.md): The single legitimate source of wall-clock time in mailglass.
 `NoDirectDateTimeNow` forbids `DateTime.utc_now/0`
outside this module.
- [Mailglass.Clock.Frozen](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Clock.Frozen.md): Test helper that freezes `Mailglass.Clock.utc_now/0` in the current
process. Per-process isolation makes it `async: true`-safe.
- [Mailglass.Clock.System](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Clock.System.md): Production clock impl. Wraps `DateTime.utc_now/0`.
- [Mailglass.Compliance](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Compliance.md): Injects RFC-required and mailglass-specific headers into outbound messages.
- [Mailglass.Compliance.Unsubscribe](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Compliance.Unsubscribe.md): Core unsubscribe token and URL service for RFC 8058 flows.
- [Mailglass.Compliance.UnsubscribeController](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Compliance.UnsubscribeController.md): Core RFC 8058 unsubscribe controller.
- [Mailglass.Components.CSS](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Components.CSS.md): CSS style-string utilities for email component rendering.
- [Mailglass.Components.Layout](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Components.Layout.md): Email document layout with MSO head and CSS reset.
- [Mailglass.Components.Theme](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Components.Theme.md): Theme-token resolver backed by `:persistent_term`.
- [Mailglass.Credo.MultiEventFirstInWebhookIngest](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.MultiEventFirstInWebhookIngest.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.NoBareOptionalDepReference](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.NoBareOptionalDepReference.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.NoCompileEnvOutsideConfig](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.NoCompileEnvOutsideConfig.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.NoDefaultModuleNameSingleton](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.NoDefaultModuleNameSingleton.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.NoDirectDateTimeNow](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.NoDirectDateTimeNow.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.NoFullResponseInLogs](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.NoFullResponseInLogs.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.NoOtherAppEnvReads](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.NoOtherAppEnvReads.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.NoOversizedUseInjection](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.NoOversizedUseInjection.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.NoPiiInResponseBody](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.NoPiiInResponseBody.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.NoPiiInTelemetryMeta](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.NoPiiInTelemetryMeta.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.NoPlanningArtifactComments](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.NoPlanningArtifactComments.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.NoRawSwooshSendInLib](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.NoRawSwooshSendInLib.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.NoTrackingOnAuthStream](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.NoTrackingOnAuthStream.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.NoUnscopedTenantQueryInLib](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.NoUnscopedTenantQueryInLib.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.PrefixedPubSubTopics](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.PrefixedPubSubTopics.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.RequireAtomicUnsubscribeHeaders](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.RequireAtomicUnsubscribeHeaders.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.StreamPolicyConsistent](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.StreamPolicyConsistent.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Credo.TelemetryEventConvention](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Credo.TelemetryEventConvention.md): ## Basics
- [Mailglass.Deliverability](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Deliverability.md): Runtime entrypoint for one-domain deliverability doctor runs.
- [Mailglass.Deliverability.BIMI](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Deliverability.BIMI.md): BIMI readiness analyzer for the default selector only.

- [Mailglass.Deliverability.DKIM](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Deliverability.DKIM.md): Explicit-selector DKIM analyzer.

- [Mailglass.Deliverability.DMARC](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Deliverability.DMARC.md): Policy-aware DMARC analyzer.

- [Mailglass.Deliverability.Formatter](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Deliverability.Formatter.md): Shared human and JSON renderers for deliverability results.

- [Mailglass.Deliverability.MX](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Deliverability.MX.md): MX and Null MX analyzer for one organizational domain.

- [Mailglass.Deliverability.Resolver](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Deliverability.Resolver.md): Mailglass-owned DNS resolver seam for deliverability checks.
- [Mailglass.Deliverability.Result](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Deliverability.Result.md): Shared plain-data contract for `mix mail.doctor` runtime results.
- [Mailglass.Deliverability.SPF](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Deliverability.SPF.md): Standards-aware SPF analyzer for one organizational domain.

- [Mailglass.Error](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Error.md): Namespace and behaviour for the mailglass error hierarchy.
- [Mailglass.Events.Event](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Events.Event.md): Append-only row in `mailglass_events`.
- [Mailglass.Events.Reconciler](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Events.Reconciler.md): Pure Ecto query functions for orphan-webhook reconciliation.
- [Mailglass.Gettext](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Gettext.md): Gettext backend for mailglass default strings.
- [Mailglass.IdempotencyKey](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.IdempotencyKey.md): Generates deterministic idempotency keys for webhook deduplication and
event-ledger entries.
- [Mailglass.Installer.Apply](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Installer.Apply.md): Applies installer operations with deterministic ordering and outcome labels.

- [Mailglass.Installer.Conflict](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Installer.Conflict.md): Conflict sidecar writer used when installer changes cannot be applied safely.

- [Mailglass.Installer.Doctor](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Installer.Doctor.md): Static webhook-wiring check for the host app's endpoint.
- [Mailglass.Installer.Manifest](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Installer.Manifest.md): `.mailglass.toml` manifest helpers for deterministic installer reruns.

- [Mailglass.Installer.Operation](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Installer.Operation.md): Typed operation contract used by the installer planner and apply engine.

- [Mailglass.Installer.Plan](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Installer.Plan.md): Deterministic installer plan builder.
- [Mailglass.Installer.Templates](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Installer.Templates.md): Installer template helpers for owned files and managed shared-file patches.

- [Mailglass.Lifecycle](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Lifecycle.md): Transaction lifecycle seam for adopter-side event composition.
- [Mailglass.Lifecycle.Noop](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Lifecycle.Noop.md): Default no-op lifecycle implementation.
- [Mailglass.Oban.TenancyMiddleware](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Oban.TenancyMiddleware.md): Serializes `Mailglass.Tenancy.current/0` across Oban job boundaries.
- [Mailglass.Operator.Deliveries](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Operator.Deliveries.md): Tenant-scoped read model for recent operator delivery browsing.

- [Mailglass.Operator.ReplayHistory](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Operator.ReplayHistory.md): Tenant-scoped read model for replay audit history on one delivery.

- [Mailglass.Operator.ReplayTargets](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Operator.ReplayTargets.md): Tenant-scoped read model for resolving a delivery detail selection to
exact replayable webhook rows.

- [Mailglass.Operator.SupportSummary](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Operator.SupportSummary.md): Tenant-scoped read model for operator support cues.

- [Mailglass.Operator.Suppressions](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Operator.Suppressions.md): Tenant-scoped read model for operator suppression visibility.

- [Mailglass.Operator.Tenants](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Operator.Tenants.md): Tenant-scoped read model for operator tenant selector choices.

- [Mailglass.Operator.Timeline](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Operator.Timeline.md): Tenant-scoped read model for operator delivery event timelines.

- [Mailglass.OptionalDeps](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.OptionalDeps.md): Namespace for optional dependency gateway modules.
- [Mailglass.OptionalDeps.GenSmtp](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.OptionalDeps.GenSmtp.md): Gateway for the optional gen_smtp dependency (`{:gen_smtp, "~> 1.3"}`).
- [Mailglass.OptionalDeps.Mjml](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.OptionalDeps.Mjml.md): Gateway for the optional MJML NIF dependency (`{:mjml, "~> 6.0"}`).
- [Mailglass.OptionalDeps.OpenTelemetry](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.OptionalDeps.OpenTelemetry.md): Gateway for the optional OpenTelemetry dependency (`{:opentelemetry, "~> 1.7"}`).
- [Mailglass.OptionalDeps.Sigra](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.OptionalDeps.Sigra.md): Gateway for the optional Sigra integration (`{:sigra, "~> 0.2"}`).
- [Mailglass.Outbound.Delivery](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Outbound.Delivery.md): One row per (Message, recipient, provider) tuple. Mutable: projection
columns are updated by `Mailglass.Outbound.Projector`.
- [Mailglass.PubSub.Topics](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.PubSub.Topics.md): Typed topic builder for `Mailglass.PubSub` (SEN, ). Every topic
is prefixed `mailglass:` —  `PrefixedPubSubTopics`
enforces the prefix at lint time.
- [Mailglass.RateLimiter](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.RateLimiter.md): Multi-bucket ETS token bucket rate limiter.
- [Mailglass.RateLimiter.Supervisor](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.RateLimiter.Supervisor.md): Supervises `Mailglass.RateLimiter.TableOwner`.
- [Mailglass.RateLimiter.TableOwner](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.RateLimiter.TableOwner.md): Init-and-idle GenServer owning the `:mailglass_rate_limit` ETS table
Owns nothing beyond ETS table creation — no `handle_call/3`,
`handle_cast/2`, or `handle_info/2` implementations. Hot-path reads
and writes happen directly from caller processes via
`:ets.update_counter/4` — NO GenServer mailbox serialization.
- [Mailglass.ReferenceHost.OperatorDiagnosisProof](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.ReferenceHost.OperatorDiagnosisProof.md): Deterministic reference-host operator diagnosis proof for a no-match route.

- [Mailglass.ReferenceHost.TrustCheckpoint](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.ReferenceHost.TrustCheckpoint.md): Deterministic trust-checkpoint encoder for reference-host journey evidence.

- [Mailglass.ReferenceHost.WebhookOperatorProof](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.ReferenceHost.WebhookOperatorProof.md): Deterministic reference-host route proof for the Postmark webhook path.

- [Mailglass.Repo](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Repo.md): Thin facade over the host-configured `Ecto.Repo`.
- [Mailglass.Router](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Router.md): Router macro for mounting Mailglass unsubscribe endpoints in an adopter
Phoenix router.
- [Mailglass.Schema](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Schema.md): Stamps mailglass-wide schema conventions onto a module.
- [Mailglass.Stream](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Stream.md): Stream policy seam (SEN stage 3, ).
- [Mailglass.Suppression.AutoSuppress](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Suppression.AutoSuppress.md): Centralized webhook-driven suppression projection helpers.

- [Mailglass.Suppression.Entry](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Suppression.Entry.md): Ecto schema for a row in `mailglass_suppressions`.
- [Mailglass.Suppression.Escalation](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Suppression.Escalation.md): Oban worker for async soft-bounce escalation.

- [Mailglass.Suppression.Resync](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Suppression.Resync.md): Tenant-scoped suppression rebuild from the append-only event ledger.

- [Mailglass.SuppressionStore](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.SuppressionStore.md): Behaviour for suppression-list storage backends.
- [Mailglass.SuppressionStore.ETS](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.SuppressionStore.ETS.md): ETS-backed implementation of `Mailglass.SuppressionStore`.
- [Mailglass.SuppressionStore.ETS.TableOwner](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.SuppressionStore.ETS.TableOwner.md): Init-and-idle GenServer owning the `:mailglass_suppression_store` ETS
table. Same pattern as `Mailglass.RateLimiter.TableOwner`.
- [Mailglass.Telemetry](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Telemetry.md): Telemetry integration for mailglass.
- [Mailglass.TemplateEngine](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.TemplateEngine.md): Behaviour for mailglass template engines.
- [Mailglass.Tenancy.ResolveFromPath](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Tenancy.ResolveFromPath.md): Opt-in URL-prefix tenant resolver ( sugar).
- [Mailglass.Tenancy.SingleTenant](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Tenancy.SingleTenant.md): Default `Mailglass.Tenancy` resolver: `scope/2` is a no-op;
`resolve_webhook_tenant/1` returns `{:ok, "default"}`.
- [Mailglass.Tracking](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Tracking.md): Tracking public facade. Off by default.
- [Mailglass.Tracking.ConfigValidator](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Tracking.ConfigValidator.md): Boot-time validator for tracking configuration.
- [Mailglass.Tracking.Guard](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Tracking.Guard.md): Runtime auth-stream tracking guard.
- [Mailglass.Tracking.Plug](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Tracking.Plug.md): Mountable Plug endpoint for open-pixel + click-redirect URLs.
- [Mailglass.Tracking.Rewriter](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Tracking.Rewriter.md): Pure HTML transform: open-pixel injection + click link rewriting.
- [Mailglass.Tracking.Token](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Tracking.Token.md): Phoenix.Token-signed tokens for open pixel + click redirect URLs.
- [Mailglass.Webhook.CachingBodyReader](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.CachingBodyReader.md): Custom `Plug.Parsers` `:body_reader` that preserves raw request
bytes in `conn.private[:raw_body]` for HMAC verification while
still allowing JSON parsing downstream.
- [Mailglass.Webhook.Ingest](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Ingest.md): Webhook ingest — the single `Ecto.Multi` that everything reduces to.
- [Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.Mailgun](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.Mailgun.md): Mailgun webhook verifier + normalizer.

- [Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.MailgunReplayCache](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.MailgunReplayCache.md): ETS-backed replay cache for Mailgun webhook tokens.

- [Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.MailgunReplayCache.Supervisor](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.MailgunReplayCache.Supervisor.md): Supervises `Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.MailgunReplayCache.TableOwner`.
- [Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.MailgunReplayCache.TableOwner](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.MailgunReplayCache.TableOwner.md): Owns the Mailgun replay cache ETS table.

- [Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.Postmark](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.Postmark.md): Postmark webhook verifier + normalizer.
- [Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.Resend](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.Resend.md): Resend webhook verifier + normalizer.
- [Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.SES](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.SES.md): AWS SES webhook verifier via Amazon SNS.
- [Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.SES.CertCache](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.SES.CertCache.md): ETS-backed SNS X.509 certificate cache for SES webhook signature verification.
- [Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.SES.CertCache.Supervisor](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.SES.CertCache.Supervisor.md): Supervises `Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.SES.CertCache.TableOwner`.
- [Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.SES.CertCache.TableOwner](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.SES.CertCache.TableOwner.md): Owns the SES SNS certificate cache ETS table.
- [Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.SES.TrustPolicy](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.SES.TrustPolicy.md): SNS URL trust-policy validation — SSRF guard for cert and subscribe URLs.
- [Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.SendGrid](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Providers.SendGrid.md): SendGrid Event Webhook verifier + normalizer.
- [Mailglass.Webhook.Replay](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Replay.md): Canonical tenant-scoped webhook replay command.

- [Mailglass.Webhook.Telemetry](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Telemetry.md): Co-located span helpers for the webhook ingest surface (CONTEXT ).
- [Mailglass.Webhook.WebhookEvent](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.WebhookEvent.md): Ecto schema for the `mailglass_webhook_events` table (V02 migration,
-01). Mutable + prunable — UNLIKE `mailglass_events` which is
append-only via the SQLSTATE 45A01 trigger (CONTEXT  split).

- Core
  - [Mailglass](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.md): Transactional email framework for Phoenix.
  - [Mailglass.Config](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Config.md): Runtime configuration for mailglass, validated at boot via NimbleOptions.
  - [Mailglass.Events](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Events.md): Append-only event writer. The only legitimate path to
`mailglass_events`.  `NoRawEventInsert` Credo check enforces
that no other code calls `Repo.insert(%Event{})` or
`Repo.insert_all("mailglass_events", ...)`.
  - [Mailglass.Message](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Message.md): A rendered or partially-rendered email message.
  - [Mailglass.Outbound](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Outbound.md): Public facade for the mailglass send pipeline.

- Authoring
  - [Mailglass.Components](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Components.md): HEEx function components for transactional email composition.
  - [Mailglass.Mailable](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Mailable.md): Behaviour + `use` macro for adopter-defined mailable modules.
  - [Mailglass.Renderer](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Renderer.md): Pure-function render pipeline: HEEx → plaintext → CSS inlining → data-mg-* strip.

- Transport
  - [Mailglass.Adapter](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Adapter.md): Behaviour every mailglass adapter implements.
  - [Mailglass.Adapters.Fake](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Adapters.Fake.md): In-memory, time-advanceable test adapter.
  - [Mailglass.Adapters.Swoosh](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Adapters.Swoosh.md): Adapter bridging to any `Swoosh.Adapter`.

- Webhooks
  - [Mailglass.Webhook](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.md): Webhook boundary root.
  - [Mailglass.Webhook.Plug](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Plug.md): Single-ingress webhook orchestrator.
  - [Mailglass.Webhook.Router](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Router.md): Router macro for mounting Mailglass webhook endpoints in an adopter
Phoenix router.

- Operations
  - [Mailglass.Tenancy](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Tenancy.md): Tenancy behaviour + process-dict helpers.
  - [Mailglass.TestAssertions](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.TestAssertions.md): Test assertions extending Swoosh.TestAssertions.

- Internal
  - [Mailglass.Adapters.Fake.Storage](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Adapters.Fake.Storage.md): GenServer owning the `:mailglass_fake_mailbox` ETS table. Mirrors
`Swoosh.Adapters.Sandbox.Storage` pattern: the GenServer handles ownership
mutations (`checkout`, `checkin`, `allow`, `set_shared`, `find_owner`,
`{:DOWN, ...}`) but READS happen directly against ETS to bypass the mailbox.
  - [Mailglass.Adapters.Fake.Supervisor](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Adapters.Fake.Supervisor.md): Supervises `Mailglass.Adapters.Fake.Storage`. Started unconditionally in
`Mailglass.Application` via the `Code.ensure_loaded?/1`-gated
`maybe_add/3` call placed in  (I-08).
  - [Mailglass.Application](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Application.md): Supervision tree for the Mailglass framework.
  - [Mailglass.Migration](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Migration.md): Public migration API for mailglass.
  - [Mailglass.Migrations.Postgres](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Migrations.Postgres.md): Internal migration runner for Postgres.
  - [Mailglass.OptionalDeps.Oban](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.OptionalDeps.Oban.md): Gateway for the optional Oban dependency (`{:oban, "~> 2.21"}`).
  - [Mailglass.Outbound.Projector](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Outbound.Projector.md): The single place where `mailglass_deliveries` projection columns are
updated. Consumed by  dispatch,  webhook ingest,
and + orphan reconciliation. No projection update happens
outside this module — a  candidate Credo check
(`NoProjectorOutsideOutbound`) will enforce at lint time.
  - [Mailglass.Outbound.Worker](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Outbound.Worker.md): Oban worker that dispatches a queued Delivery (SEN). Conditionally
compiled — entire module elided when `:oban` is not loaded.
  - [Mailglass.PubSub](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.PubSub.md): Name atom for the mailglass-owned Phoenix.PubSub child.
  - [Mailglass.Suppression](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Suppression.md): Public preflight facade for suppression checks (SEN).
  - [Mailglass.SuppressionStore.ETS.Supervisor](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.SuppressionStore.ETS.Supervisor.md): Supervises `Mailglass.SuppressionStore.ETS.TableOwner`.
  - [Mailglass.SuppressionStore.Ecto](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.SuppressionStore.Ecto.md): Default Ecto-backed `Mailglass.SuppressionStore` implementation.
  - [Mailglass.TemplateEngine.HEEx](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.TemplateEngine.HEEx.md): Default HEEx template engine for mailglass.
  - [Mailglass.Webhook.Provider](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Provider.md): Behaviour for webhook providers (SendGrid, Postmark, etc).
  - [Mailglass.Webhook.Pruner](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Pruner.md): Oban cron worker that prunes `mailglass_webhook_events` rows by
status + age (CONTEXT ).
  - [Mailglass.Webhook.Reconciler](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Webhook.Reconciler.md): Reconcile orphan webhook events against committed deliveries.

- Exceptions
  - [Mailglass.ConfigError](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.ConfigError.md): Raised when mailglass is misconfigured.
  - [Mailglass.Error.BatchFailed](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.Error.BatchFailed.md): Raised by `Mailglass.Outbound.deliver_many!/2` when one or more
deliveries in the batch have `status: :failed`.
  - [Mailglass.EventLedgerImmutableError](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.EventLedgerImmutableError.md): Raised when the `mailglass_events` append-only immutability trigger fires.
  - [Mailglass.PublishError](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.PublishError.md): Raised when installer golden drift is detected during the `mix mailglass.publish.check` task.
  - [Mailglass.RateLimitError](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.RateLimitError.md): Raised when a rate limit is exceeded.
  - [Mailglass.SendError](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.SendError.md): Raised when email delivery fails.
  - [Mailglass.SignatureError](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.SignatureError.md): Raised when webhook signature verification fails.
  - [Mailglass.StreamPolicyError](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.StreamPolicyError.md): Raised when a message violates stream policy.
  - [Mailglass.SuppressedError](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.SuppressedError.md): Raised when delivery is blocked by the suppression list.
  - [Mailglass.TemplateError](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.TemplateError.md): Raised when a template cannot be compiled or rendered.
  - [Mailglass.TenancyError](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mailglass.TenancyError.md): Raised when tenant context is required but not stamped on the process.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix mail.doctor](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mail.Doctor.md): Run DNS-only deliverability checks for one explicit domain.
- [mix mailglass.docs.check](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Docs.Check.md): Fail the build if Tier 1 docs leak internal IDs or drift away from the
canonical stability-contract story. The checks are deterministic and scoped
to release-blocking docs only.
- [mix mailglass.doctor](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Doctor.md): Run a static webhook-wiring check on the host app's `endpoint.ex`.
- [mix mailglass.gen.inbound_route](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Gen.InboundRoute.md): Appends a `route/2` clause to an existing `MailglassInbound.Router` module.
- [mix mailglass.gen.inbound_router](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Gen.InboundRouter.md): Scaffolds a new inbound router module.
- [mix mailglass.gen.mailable](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Gen.Mailable.md): Scaffolds a new Mailable module and its associated HEEx template.
- [mix mailglass.gen.mailbox](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Gen.Mailbox.md): Scaffolds an inbound mailbox and wires it into your router.
- [mix mailglass.gen.migration](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Gen.Migration.md): Generates the 8-line wrapper migration file in `priv/repo/migrations/`
that delegates `up/0` and `down/0` to `Mailglass.Migration`.
- [mix mailglass.gen.unsubscribe](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Gen.Unsubscribe.md): Prints the read-only Mailglass unsubscribe installation checklist.
- [mix mailglass.install](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Install.md): Install mailglass into a Phoenix host app.
- [mix mailglass.publish.check](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Publish.Check.md): Verify the published tarball before Hex.pm release.
- [mix mailglass.reconcile](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Reconcile.md): Manually trigger the same reconciliation sweep that
`Mailglass.Webhook.Reconciler` runs on its Oban cron schedule.
- [mix mailglass.repo.hygiene](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Repo.Hygiene.md): Audits repository release hygiene before release or milestone work.
- [mix mailglass.stability.check](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Stability.Check.md): Ensures that `Swoosh.Email.t()` types do not leak into the `Mailglass`
public namespace, preventing downstream developers from accidentally coupling
to our internal engine's types.
- [mix mailglass.suppressions.resync](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Suppressions.Resync.md): Rebuilds `mailglass_suppressions` from the append-only event ledger for one tenant.
- [mix mailglass.trust.run](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Trust.Run.md): Run the canonical deterministic trust-runner stage pipeline.
- [mix mailglass.upgrade.v0_2](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Upgrade.V0_2.md): Transitional codemod that upgrades adopter code from raw `Swoosh.Email`
usage to native `Mailglass.Message` setters.
- [mix mailglass.webhooks.prune](https://mailglass.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mailglass.Webhooks.Prune.md): Manually trigger the same retention sweep that
`Mailglass.Webhook.Pruner` runs on its Oban cron schedule.
